71: ### 1.1 webOS 8.5.0 Hardware & Memory Architecture Constraints
72: 1. **Physical RAM Constraint (1.5 GB)**: The target LG 32LR686BPSA television contains **1.5 GB of shared physical RAM**. This memory is partitioned between:
73:    - Linux kernel and low-level drivers (~300 MB)
74:    - webOS system services, Luna Service Bus, SurfaceFlinger graphics compositor (~450 MB)
75:    - Hardware video decoder / audio DSP shared memory buffers (~200 MB)
76:    - Web application Chromium runtime (~250–350 MB max before OOM termination).
77: 2. **Chromium Out-Of-Memory (OOM) Killer Threshold**: In webOS 8.5, when the web application process RSS exceeds its allocated cgroup threshold (~350 MB), the webOS low-memory killer immediately sends `SIGKILL`, terminating the application without warning.
78: 3. **MSE SourceBuffer Accumulation Hazard**: By default, `hls.js` retains up to 60 MB of media data in memory and allows backward buffer retention up to `Infinity` (`backBufferLength: Infinity`). In a standard 2-hour movie, unevicted fMP4 chunks accumulate linearly, causing the browser process to consume >150 MB solely for video buffers.
79: 4. **Hardware Video Decoder Pipeline (VPU/VDEC) Lockup**: webOS hardware only supports 1–2 concurrent hardware video decoder contexts. If a `<video>` element's source is not cleanly cleared and `video.load()` is not called upon teardown, the hardware decoder context remains locked. Attempting to start subsequent video playback results in a black screen, silent video, or `MEDIA_ERR_DECODE`.
80: 5. **Dual-Environment Portability**: The player engine must execute seamlessly in:
81:    - Production: LG webOS 8.5.0 Chromium ~108+ with native MediaSource Extensions and local Node.js proxy daemon.
82:    - Test Harness: Headless Node.js + JSDOM runner where `window.Hls`, `HTMLMediaElement`, and `fetch` are mocked.

88: ### 2.1 Endpoint Contracts & URL Construction
89: The player engine interacts with three local proxy endpoints exposed on `http://127.0.0.1:8088`:
90: 
91: #### A. Stream Resolution Endpoint (`GET /api/stream`)
92: - **Base URL**: Configured via `CINEJOY_CONFIG.proxyBaseUrl` (defaults to `'http://127.0.0.1:8088'`).
93: - **Query Parameters**:
94:   - `tmdbId` (string | number): TMDB title identifier (e.g. `27205` for Inception).
95:   - `type` (string): `'movie'` | `'tv'`.
96:   - `season` (string | number, required if `type === 'tv'`): Season number.
97:   - `episode` (string | number, required if `type === 'tv'`): Episode number.
98:   - `server` (string, optional): Target cluster server (defaults to `'secret'`).
99: - **Response Format (JSON HTTP 200)**:
100:   ```json
101:   {
102:     "success": true,
103:     "streamUrl": "http://127.0.0.1:8088/hls/proxy?url=https%3A%2F%2Flightspeed.st%2Fhls%2F8e7e7dad-ed31-47d4-8243-925232bdeae3%2F1%2Fmaster.m3u8",
104:     "originalUrl": "https://lightspeed.st/hls/8e7e7dad-ed31-47d4-8243-925232bdeae3/1/master.m3u8",
105:     "server": "secret",
106:     "subtitles": [
107:       {
108:         "label": "English",
109:         "srclang": "en",
110:         "src": "http://127.0.0.1:8088/proxy/sub?url=https%3A%2F%2Fsubs.wing.st%2Fsub%2F..."
111:       }
112:     ]
113:   }
114:   ```
115: - **Error Responses**:
116:   - `400 Bad Request`: Missing mandatory parameters (`tmdbId`, `type`, `season`, `episode`).
117:   - `502 Bad Gateway`: Cryptographic sealing or gateway handshake failed across cluster servers.
118: 
119: #### B. HLS Proxy Endpoint (`GET /hls/proxy`)
120: - Used as the target stream URL for `hls.js` (`hls.loadSource(streamUrl)`).
121: - Takes query parameter `url` containing the URL-encoded target M3U8 or fMP4 `.png` segment URL.
122: - Automatically handles header injection (`Origin: https://cinejoy.pk`, `Referer: https://cinejoy.pk/`), URI rewriting for child variant playlists and chunks, and byte-range streaming for seeking.
123: 
124: #### C. Subtitle Proxy Endpoint (`GET /proxy/sub`)
125: - Takes query parameter `url` pointing to remote `.srt` subtitle on `subs.wing.st`.
126: - Injects necessary referer headers and on-the-fly converts SubRip format (`.srt`) to WebVTT (`.vtt`) with `Content-Type: text/vtt; charset=utf-8`.
127: 
128: #### D. Active Server Cluster Discovery (`GET /api/servers`)
129: - Queries available streaming cluster nodes:
130:   ```json
131:   {
132:     "servers": [
133:       { "name": "secret", "4k": true, "status": "ok" },
134:       { "name": "Nebula", "4k": false, "status": "ok" },
135:       { "name": "Lisbon", "4k": true, "status": "ok" },
136:       { "name": "Solara", "4k": false, "status": "ok" },

142: ### 2.2 Client-Side Stream Resolution Algorithm
143: The resolver client inside `player.js` executes the following algorithm:
144: 
145: ```javascript
146: async function resolveStreamFromProxy(itemPayload, preferredServer) {
147:   var baseUrl = (window.CINEJOY_CONFIG && window.CINEJOY_CONFIG.proxyBaseUrl) || 'http://127.0.0.1:8088';
148:   var mediaType = (itemPayload.type === 'tv' || itemPayload.media_type === 'tv') ? 'tv' : 'movie';
149:   var tmdbId = itemPayload.tmdbId || itemPayload.id;
150:   
151:   if (!tmdbId) {
152:     throw new Error('RESOLVE_INVALID_ID: Missing tmdbId in playback item payload');
153:   }
154: 
155:   var params = new URLSearchParams();
156:   params.set('tmdbId', String(tmdbId));
157:   params.set('type', mediaType);
158:   if (mediaType === 'tv') {
159:     params.set('season', String(itemPayload.season || 1));
160:     params.set('episode', String(itemPayload.episode || 1));
161:   }
162:   params.set('server', preferredServer || itemPayload.server || 'secret');
163: 
164:   var url = baseUrl + '/api/stream?' + params.toString();
165: 
166:   var controller = new AbortController();
167:   var timeoutId = setTimeout(function () {
168:     controller.abort();
169:   }, 12000); // 12-second stream resolution timeout
170: 
171:   try {
172:     var response = await fetch(url, {
173:       method: 'GET',
174:       headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' },
175:       signal: controller.signal
176:     });
177: 
178:     clearTimeout(timeoutId);
179: 
180:     if (!response.ok) {
181:       var errData = null;
182:       try { errData = await response.json(); } catch (_) {}
183:       var msg = (errData && errData.error) || ('Proxy HTTP ' + response.status);
184:       throw new Error('RESOLVE_HTTP_ERROR: ' + msg);
185:     }
186: 
187:     var result = await response.json();
188:     if (!result.success || !result.streamUrl) {
189:       throw new Error('RESOLVE_NO_STREAM: Stream URL not present in proxy response');
190:     }
191: 
192:     return {
193:       streamUrl: result.streamUrl,
194:       originalUrl: result.originalUrl,
195:       server: result.server || preferredServer || 'secret',
196:       subtitles: Array.isArray(result.subtitles) ? result.subtitles : []
197:     };
198:   } catch (err) {
199:     clearTimeout(timeoutId);
200:     if (err.name === 'AbortError') {
201:       throw new Error('RESOLVE_TIMEOUT: Stream resolution timed out after 12s');
202:     }
203:     throw err;
204:   }
205: }
206: ```

467: ## 4. WebOS TV 1.5GB RAM Memory Safety & Teardown Architecture
468: 
469: ### 4.1 The TV Memory Leak Threat Model
470: On LG webOS TV devices, the most frequent cause of application termination is accumulated memory leakage from media playback. When a user watches trailer A, exits, watches movie B, exits, and watches series C:
471: - **Decoder Context Leak**: Failing to call `video.load()` leaves the hardware video decoder pipeline locked, causing subsequent videos to fail with hardware decoder exhaustion.
472: - **MediaSource / SourceBuffer Bloat**: Failing to detach and destroy `hls.js` leaves internal demuxers and arrays allocated in native memory.
473: - **Dangling Event Listeners**: Listeners bound to `window`, `document`, or `video` prevent garbage collection of closures containing large objects.
474: - **Leaked Intervals**: Uncancelled `setInterval` timers for resume tracking or OSD auto-hiding leak CPU cycles and trigger state mutations after view switching.
475: 
476: ### 4.2 The 5-Stage Deterministic `destroy()` Protocol
477: The `PlayerController.destroy()` method executes a rigorous, order-dependent 5-stage teardown:
478: 
479: ```javascript
480: PlayerController.prototype.destroy = function () {
481:   console.log('[PlayerController] Initiating deterministic teardown...');
482: 
483:   // STAGE 1: Cancel All Timers & Interval Tasks
484:   if (this._resumeSaveTimer) {
485:     clearInterval(this._resumeSaveTimer);
486:     this._resumeSaveTimer = null;
487:   }
488:   if (this._streamTimeoutTimer) {
489:     clearTimeout(this._streamTimeoutTimer);
490:     this._streamTimeoutTimer = null;
491:   }
492:   if (this._abortController) {
493:     this._abortController.abort();
494:     this._abortController = null;
495:   }
496: 
497:   // Persist final position before destroying
498:   this.savePlaybackPosition();
499: 
500:   // STAGE 2: Unbind All Video Element DOM Listeners
501:   if (this.videoElement) {
502:     this._unbindVideoListeners(this.videoElement);
503:     try {
504:       this.videoElement.pause();
505:     } catch (_) {}
506:   }
507: 
508:   // STAGE 3: Teardown and Destroy Hls.js Instance
509:   if (this.hls) {

559: ### 5.1 Storage Schema & Key Normalization
560: Playback positions are persisted to the browser's `localStorage` engine with a deterministic naming format:

562: - **Movies**: `cinejoy_playback_{tmdbId}_movie_0_0`

565: #### Key Generation Helper:

568:   var mType = (type === 'tv' || type === 'series') ? 'tv' : 'movie';
569:   if (mType === 'tv') {
570:     return 'cinejoy_playback_' + tmdbId + '_tv_' + (season || 1) + '_' + (episode || 1);
571:   }
572:   return 'cinejoy_playback_' + tmdbId + '_movie_0_0';
573: }

576: #### Persisted Record Format:
577: ```json

579:   "tmdbId": 27205,
580:   "type": "movie",
581:   "season": 0,
582:   "episode": 0,
583:   "title": "Inception",
584:   "position": 1425.5,
585:   "duration": 8880.0,

591: ### 5.2 Persistence Cadence
592: 1. **Periodic Timer**: A 5000ms (`setInterval`) timer runs continuously while `state === 'PLAYING'`.
593: 2. **Event-Driven**: Persisted immediately upon:
594:    - User pauses playback (`pause()`)
595:    - User executes seek (+/-10s or scrub)
596:    - View navigation exits player (`deactivate()`, `exitPlayer()`)

598:    - Window `beforeunload` / `pagehide`

600: ### 5.3 Position Restoration Rules
601: When a title loads, the engine inspects `localStorage` and determines whether to resume playback:
602: 
603: ```javascript
604: function evaluateResumePosition(storageRecord, mediaDuration) {
605:   if (!storageRecord || typeof storageRecord.position !== 'number') {
606:     return null;
607:   }
608: 
609:   var pos = storageRecord.position;
610:   var dur = mediaDuration || storageRecord.duration || 0;
611: 
612:   // RULE 1: Under 10 Seconds -> Ignore (user was in studio logos / opening credits)
613:   if (pos <= 10) {
614:     return null;
615:   }
616: 
617:   // RULE 2: Near End of Video (within 60 seconds of completion) -> Ignore & Clear
618:   // (Prevents resuming directly into credit crawl when starting a re-watch)
619:   if (dur > 60 && pos >= (dur - 60)) {
620:     return null;
621:   }
622: 
623:   // Valid resume target
624:   return {
625:     position: pos,
626:     duration: dur,
627:     percentage: dur > 0 ? (pos / dur) * 100 : 0
628:   };
629: }
630: ```

632: ### 5.4 Completion Clean-Up Rule
633: When video playback reaches the end (the `ended` event fires or `currentTime >= duration - 60`), the engine automatically cleans up the `localStorage` key so the next play begins cleanly from the start:
634: ```javascript
635: function clearCompletedPlayback(storageKey) {
636:   try {
637:     localStorage.removeItem(storageKey);
638:   } catch (_) {}
639: }
640: ```

91:   - Query parameters:
92:     - `tmdbId`: string (e.g. `"27205"`)
93:     - `type`: `"movie"` | `"tv"`
94:     - `season`: string (optional, for tv)
95:     - `episode`: string (optional, for tv)

98:     ```json

100:       "success": true,
101:       "streamUrl": "http://127.0.0.1:8088/hls/proxy?url=https%3A%2F%2Flightspeed.st%2Fhls%2F...%2Fmaster.m3u8",

110:   - Forwards request to target with headers `Origin: https://cinejoy.pk` and `Referer: https://cinejoy.pk/`.
